_note: Cross-source elimination disagreements >2x that are deliberate or explained, waived for EliminationConsistencyTests. `pair` names the comparison: halflife-db (HalfLifeDatabase fallback vs the DB-resolved t1/2), halflife-pk (fallback vs the PK-derived t1/2), override (SubstanceModelDatabase felt-effect ke patch vs any measured source). Every entry needs a non-empty prose `note` — the loader refuses an empty one. A waiver that stops tripping fails the suite (stale-entry test); delete it then. Reseed candidates with PIRU_ELIM_DUMP=1 (writes Audits/elimination-violations.json). Entries marked 'unverified disagreement' are open data questions, not explanations — fixing the data retires them.
